column3: NASB reads this verse as the end of Moses’ speech with the future “shall perform”; the Hebrew can also be read as narrative, “Bezalel … worked.” “the construction of the sanctuary” renders “the service of the holy place.”
“every skillful person” renders “every wise of heart,” and “whose heart stirred him” renders “whose heart lifted him.”
“the construction of the sanctuary” renders “the service of the holy place,” and “every morning” renders “morning by morning.”
“the construction work” renders “the service for the work,” and NASB supplies “us.”
NASB supplies the name “Bezalel” where the Hebrew has “he made them.”
“porpoise skins” renders “tahash skins,” an animal whose identity is uncertain.
“the rear” renders “the innermost (farthest) parts” (also in verses 28 and 32).
“double” renders “twins”; the construction of the corner frames is uncertain.
“two under every board” renders the repeated “two sockets, two sockets under each board.”
